p1: David went down to a little stream. He chose five smooth stones from the water. He put them in his shepherd’s bag.
He held his sling, a strap for throwing stones far. Then David walked toward the giant.
Goliath had a sword, a spear, and a shield. David said, “I come to you in the name of the Lord.” David was trusting the Lord, not a sword.
p2: David said, “The battle is the Lord’s.” He wanted everyone to know the Lord saves without swords. David threw one stone, and the giant fell down. David had no sword at all!
When you have a hard thing to do, the Lord is with you. Tonight, tell Him one hard thing. You never have to be brave alone.
old: Israel’s enemies had a HUGE giant soldier named Goliath. He was over nine feet tall! Every day he yelled, “Send me a fighter!” All of Israel’s soldiers were too scared.
A young shepherd boy named David came to bring food to his brothers. He heard Goliath shouting mean things. David said, “I’ll fight him! Heavenly Father will help me!”
David didn’t wear heavy armor. He just had his sling and five smooth stones. He told Goliath, “You have a sword, but I come in the name of the Lord!”
David swung his sling and a stone flew through the air. THUD! It hit Goliath right on the forehead. The giant fell down! David won because Heavenly Father was with him!
